name: Reading Stream
description: A line down the side of an article that fills with water as you read, with a droplet at its end and a ring for each section.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the filled line, the droplet and passed markers. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: container
props.description: A scrolling element to follow instead of the window.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which reserves a 40px gutter on the left (64px from the sm breakpoint) for the line. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: The article. The line fills down to a reading line 40% of the way down the view, which moves to the bottom edge as the page reaches its end.

props.name: children
props.description: A section of the article. It adds a ring to the line, level with the middle of its first line of text, that fills once the line reaches it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the section element. Other section props are passed through, including ref.
